purpose: test whether the Pythia-14M static finite-pair decoder returns to its predicted local O(eta^2) regime when one-step stage learning rates are reduced, after T2 showed state-conditioned tail failure already at one update with eta=1e-4

codebook_seed_derivation.method: first four big-endian uint32 words of SHA256(label)
codebook_seed_derivation.label: chronotrace-pythia14m-t2b-lr-map-v1

learning_rate_selection_rule: none; every frozen rate is reported and no rate is promoted by post-hoc optimization

stage_randomness.rule: stage-specific seed is reset on every stage-map invocation so stochasticity cannot encode macro position

pre_registered_checks.check_1_asymptotic_restoration: at least three of four fresh codebooks reach 6/6 exact full-order recovery at one or more rates below 1e-4 while finite-pair signatures remain identifiable
pre_registered_checks.check_2_tail_robustness_improves: for at least three of four fresh codebooks, minimum tail robustness at 1e-6 is greater than minimum tail robustness at 1e-4
pre_registered_checks.check_3_pair_scaling: report without selection the log-log slope of mean base-commutator norm versus eta; the local theory predicts an approach toward slope 2 before numerical resolution dominates
pre_registered_checks.check_4_third_order_relative_decay: for at least three of four fresh codebooks, maximum third-order residual divided by minimum finite-pair signature separation is smaller at 1e-6 than at 1e-4
pre_registered_checks.check_5_error_structure: report whether any remaining errors cease to be same-prefix tail swaps as eta decreases

numerical_floor_rule: conditions remain in the scientific table even if signatures become non-identifiable; failure to restore chronology is called mechanistic evidence only where finite-pair signatures are still identifiable, otherwise the condition is marked numerically unresolved
scale_decision: 31M remains blocked until T2b is completed and interpreted; no 31M chronology endpoint may be trained from this branch before that decision
